proposition: Khwandamir's brief notice, as reported by Melvin-Koushki, names three works of Ibn Turka (the Fusus commentary, the Mafahis and the Sharh-i Nazm al-Durr); the Tamhid is not among the three named.

mediation.note: A very brief notice; absence of the Tamhid from it is not a claim Khwandamir makes.
Reported through MK, who argues a rival reading.
